title: Signal: Composer accepts cleartext package downloads
scope: A composer.json file that declares `secure-http` turned off, which permits http downloads.
limitations: It matches `secure-http` turned off, which permits http downloads in the parsed composer.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A composer.json that mentions `secure-http` turned off, which permits http downloads in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
